38603-the-lost-gold-of-the-montezumas-a-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Behind this altar-like structure a vast wall of the natural rock, a dark limestone, had been sculptured into the shape of a colossal and exceedingly ugly human face,--as if the head of a stone giant were half sunken in that side of what was evidently an immense cave.

arxiv-1710-10218.title: Effective Field Theory for Dark Matter Direct Detection up to Dimension Seven Preprint: DO-TH 17/21
arxiv-1710-10218.creator: Joachim Brod, Aaron Gootjes-Dreesbach, Michele Tammaro, Jure Zupan
arxiv-1710-10218.description: Abstract We present the full basis of effective operators relevant for dark matter direct detection, up to and including operators of mass dimension seven. We treat the cases where dark matter is either a Dirac fermion, a Majorana fermion, a complex scalar, or a real scalar, allowing for dark matter to furnish a general representation of the electroweak gauge group.

arxiv-2104-04318.title: Noisy-Labeled NER with Confidence Estimation
arxiv-2104-04318.creator: Kun Liu Yao Fu Chuanqi Tan Mosha Chen, Ningyu Zhang Songfang Huang Sheng Gao
arxiv-2104-04318.description: Abstract Recent studies in deep learning have shown significant progress in named entity recognition (NER). Most existing works assume clean data annotation, yet a fundamental challenge in real-world scenarios is the large amount of noise from a variety of sources (e.g., pseudo, weak, or distant annotations). This work studies NER under a noisy labeled setting with calibrated confidence estimation.

arxiv-2404-13588.title: Machine Unlearning via Null Space Calibration
arxiv-2404-13588.creator: Huiqiang Chen, Tianqing Zhu, Xin Yu, Wanlei Zhou
arxiv-2404-13588.description: Abstract Machine unlearning aims to enable models to forget specific data instances when receiving deletion requests. Current research centres on efficient unlearning to erase the influence of data from the model and neglects the subsequent impacts on the remaining data. Consequently, existing unlearning algorithms degrade the model’s performance after unlearning, known as over-unlearning .

arxiv-2405-11460.title: Structural properties, dielectric relaxation and impedance spectroscopy of NASICON type Na 3+x Zr 2-x Pr x Si 2 PO 12 ceramics
arxiv-2405-11460.creator: Ramcharan Meena, Rajendra S. Dhaka
arxiv-2405-11460.description: Abstract We investigate the dielectric and impedance spectroscopic investigation of Pr-doped NASICON type Na 3+x Zr 2-x Pr x Si 2 PO 12 ( x = x= 0.05–0.2) samples as a function of temperature and frequency. The Rietveld refinement of x-ray diffraction patterns confirms the monoclinic phase having C2/c space groups for all the samples.

arxiv-2408-06087.title: Building Decision Making Models Through Language Model Regime
arxiv-2408-06087.creator: Yu Zhang Haoxiang Liu Feijun Jiang Weihua Luo Kaifu Zhang
arxiv-2408-06087.description: Abstract We propose a novel approach for decision making problems leveraging the generalization capabilities of large language models (LLMs). Traditional methods such as expert systems, planning algorithms, and reinforcement learning often exhibit limited generalization, typically requiring the training of new models for each unique task.

arxiv-2409-07733.creator: Subhabrata Dutta, Dipankar Das, Tanmoy Chakraborty
arxiv-2409-07733.description: Abstract The self-similarity of complex systems has been studied intensely across different domains [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] due to its potential applications in system modeling, complexity analysis, etc., as well as for deep theoretical interest.

arxiv-2509-07912.title: RSK and Quantum Symmetric Functions: A Combinatorial Approach
arxiv-2509-07912.creator: Eddy Pariguan, Jhoan Sierra V
arxiv-2509-07912.description: Abstract We explore an application of the Robinson–Schensted–Knuth (RSK) algorithm in the context of the quantum product of multi-symmetric functions. After reviewing the combinatorial foundations of quantum symmetric functions, we establish connections with transportation polytopes. Our approach highlights the combinatorial richness underlying the star product of symmetric functions.

britannica-1911-canitz-friedrich-rudolf-.title: Canitz, Friedrich Rudolf Ludwig (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-canitz-friedrich-rudolf-.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-canitz-friedrich-rudolf-.description: Article 'Canitz, Friedrich Rudolf Ludwig' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. (1654–1699), German poet and diplomatist, was born at Berlin on the 27th of November 1654. He attended the universities of Leiden and Leipzig, travelled in England, France, Italy and Holland, and on his return was appointed groom of the bedchamber (Kammerjunker) to the elector Frederick William of Brandenburg, whom he accompanied on his campaigns in Pomerania and Sweden.

pmc-10735974.title: SENIOR CITIZEN SCIENCE FOR AGE-FRIENDLY COMMUNITIES
pmc-10735974.creator: Helen Barrie
pmc-10735974.description: This presentation explores the use of citizen science with older participants; highlighting the potential for this underutilized methodology to create better, data driven, outcomes for age friendly cities and communities. Local neighborhoods have major impacts on older people’s mobility, autonomy and independence, and quality of life. The WHO has developed clear guidelines for achieving age-friendly cities or communities.

pmc-11293741.title: Improving semi-arid agroecosystem services with cover crop mixes
pmc-11293741.creator: Elizabeth A Moore, Urszula Norton, Taimoor Hassan Farooq, Taimoor Hassan Farooq, Taimoor Hassan Farooq, Taimoor Hassan Farooq
pmc-11293741.description: Winter wheat (Triticum aestivum, L.) production in the semi-arid US Northern High Plains (NHP) is challenged by frequent droughts and water-limited, low fertility soils. Composted cattle manure (compost) and cover crops (CC) are known to provide agroecosystem services such as improved soil health, and in the CC case, increased plant diversity, and competition with weedy species.

pmc-11507459.title: Co-Design Model of Support for Child and Family Health Nurse Practice with Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Families
pmc-11507459.creator: Mehrnoush Bonakdar Tehrani, Stacy Blythe, Suza Trajkovski, Lynn Kemp
pmc-11507459.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Culturally and linguistically diverse (CALD) mothers with young children face multiple inequities in accessing primary health services, such as language barriers, social isolation, low health literacy, and the availability of appropriate interpretation services. These inequities are persistent and indicate that child and family health nurse (CFHN) services, the providers of primary healthcare in many developed countries, require better support to address the needs of these families.

pmc-11550727.title: Tiny but mighty: Diverse functions of uORFs that regulate gene expression
pmc-11550727.creator: Zhenfei Zhong, Yajie Li, Qinmiao Sun, Dahua Chen
pmc-11550727.description: Upstream open reading frames (uORFs) are critical cis-acting regulators of downstream gene expression. Specifically, uORFs regulate translation by disrupting translation initiation or mediating mRNA decay. We herein summarize the effects of several uORFs that regulate gene expression in microbes to illustrate the detailed mechanisms mediating uORF functions. Microbes are ideal for uORF studies because of their prompt responses to stimuli.

pmc-11609287.title: The mortality impacts of greening Italy
pmc-11609287.creator: Orazio Valerio Giannico, Rodolfo Sardone, Lucia Bisceglia, Francesco Addabbo, Francesco Pirotti, Sante Minerba, Antonia Mincuzzi
pmc-11609287.description: Green spaces have been shown to be beneficial to humans, but quantifying these benefits is a challenge for epidemiology. In this health impact assessment study, we exploit satellites to estimate for the whole of Italy the number of deaths that could be prevented in the 49 million adult population by greening residential areas.

pmc-13501855.creator: Porntera Sethalao, Nithima Ratanasit, Decho Jakrapanichakul, Sasima Tongsai, Sirichai Jamnongprasatporn
pmc-13501855.description: BackgroundSevere primary mitral regurgitation (MR) linked to substantial morbidity and mortality. However, racial differences impact the left ventricular size, which subsequently influence specific echocardiographic parameters. In this context, the left ventricular stroke volume index (LVSVi) may serve as a valuable prognostic indicator.

uslaw-usc-t46-s9102.title: 46 U.S.C. § 9102 — Standards for tank vessels of the United States
uslaw-usc-t46-s9102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t46-s9102.description: United States Code, Title 46 (Shipping); Part F (Manning Of Vessels); Chapter 91 (Tank Vessel Manning Standards). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall prescribe standards for the manning of each vessel of the United States to which chapter 37 of this title applies, related to the duties, qualifications, and training of the officers and crew of the vessel, including standards.
